title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 26514 documentation requirements (code-level projection)
description: Criterion set used as the primary evaluation axis. Requirements that govern a document set are marked level=document-set so they can be excluded from the entity-level rubric; see docs/CRITERIA_ISO.md.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.definition: The documentation states facts about the entity that match its implementation.

criteria.name: Consistency
criteria.definition: Terminology and claims do not contradict the rest of the documentation.

criteria.name: Comprehensibility
criteria.definition: A reader familiar with the project can understand the description.

criteria.name: Conciseness
criteria.definition: The description avoids redundancy and unnecessary detail.

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.definition: Core functionality, inputs, outputs, and preconditions are covered.

criteria.name: Modularity
criteria.definition: Information is organised into coherent, self-contained units.

criteria.name: Structured by Function
criteria.definition: Content is grouped by the function it serves rather than arbitrarily.

criteria.name: Navigability
criteria.definition: A reader can locate the relevant information about the entity.

criteria.name: Metadata
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Each topic should include metadata (e.g., audience, product version, information type) to facilitate content management and retrieval.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}

criteria.name: Consistent Format
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Uses a unified style guide (fonts, colors, icons, warning formats, etc.); maintains consistent formatting for both print and electronic documents.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}

criteria.name: Legibility
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Font size and color contrast are suitable for the reading environment; avoids all-caps text, excessive italics, or underlining.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}

criteria.name: Illustrations and Media
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Graphics should be clear and consistent, placed adjacent to relevant text; avoids culturally sensitive images; videos and animations should be brief and have control options.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Representation of Interactive Elements
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Uses consistent graphics or formats to represent keyboard shortcuts, mouse actions, touch gestures, etc.; uses symbols or graphics to distinguish literal values from variables.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Multi-modal Support
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Provides text alternatives for non-text content (images, videos, audio); supports screen readers, high-contrast modes, etc.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Device Independence
criteria.definition: {'definition': "Avoids dependencies on specific devices (e.g., 'click the green button'); provides instructions for multiple operation methods (keyboard, voice, touch, etc.).", 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Accessibility Features
criteria.definition: {'definition': "Clearly explains the software's accessibility features and how to use them.", 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Cultural Neutrality
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Avoids culture-specific examples, humor, and images; uses internationally recognized date, currency, and measurement unit formats.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}

criteria.name: Translation-Friendly
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Uses simple sentences, consistent terminology, and avoids abbreviations and slang; text in graphics should be separable to facilitate translation.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}

criteria.name: Space Consideration
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Reserves space for text expansion (e.g., German and Finnish text is typically longer than English).', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: User-Centered Design
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Designs content based on user tasks and roles; provides context-sensitive help.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}

criteria.name: Testing and Feedback
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Conducts usability testing to ensure information is easy to find, use, and understand; collects user feedback for continuous improvement.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Search and Indexing
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Provides full-text search, Boolean search, and filtering capabilities; indexes should include synonyms and user-friendly terms.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Safety Information
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Safety information (e.g., danger, warning, caution) should be prominent and consistent; uses standard signal words (Danger, Warning, Caution).', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Legal and Copyright
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Includes copyright notices, trademark information, and license terms; complies with relevant laws and regulations (e.g., Section 508, ISO standards).', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Version Control
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Documentation should be updated in sync with software versions; uses configuration management (CM) systems to manage changes.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.

criteria.name: Change Log
criteria.definition: {'definition': 'Clearly identifies new or modified content; provides release notes and compatibility information.', 'source': '5Score/DOTquality_mul_Eval.jsonl'}
criteria.note: Governs a document set, not a single code entity; excluded from the entity-level rubric.
